sentences.en: Donnie had pretty well taken over the project as the chores of Bird Song limited Cynthia's time.

sentences.en: Aunt Queenie, a lesser witch, somewhat demonstrative and ill-advised, gave well-taken opportunities to Betty Elliott.

sentences.en: The visitors, who squandered several chances early on, had gone ahead on 32 minutes through Carlton Miller 's well taken strike.
